title: Florida House, District 53
what_it_does: Represents District 53 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Open seat (incumbent Republican Jeff Holcomb switched to another race). Republican Brian Hawkins won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary over John Carroll and faces Democrat Tony Claude and Constitution Party candidate Christopher Anger on Nov. 3.
verified_ballot_note: Tampa Bay Times (Aug. 18, 2026): 'HD 53 (Hernando & Pasco Counties) Republican Primary: This open seat was won by Brian Hawkins against John Carroll' (https://www.tampabay.com/news/florida-politics/elections/2026/08/18/florida-legislature-house-senate-legislative-results-primary-2026/). Hernando Sun's candidate roundup (July 30, 2026) lists Democrat Tony Claude and Constitution Party candidate Christopher Anger as the general-election opponents (https://www.hernandosun.com/2026/07/30/state-house-dist-53-candidates/). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.

candidates.name: Brian Hawkins
candidates.background: Hernando County Commissioner (District 2) since 2022 who resigned to run for HD 53 (western Hernando and northwest Pasco). Won the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary over John Carroll.
candidates.primary_result: Won Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary over John Carroll (Tampa Bay Times)
